title: Urali language
description: Dialect of Irula, a Dravidian language spoken in India
extract: Urali is a dialect of Irula, a southern Dravidian language. It is spoken by the Urali tribe in the hills around Idukki in Kerala, and Bargur in Tamil Nadu. It is still commonly spoken among the community.
